# Native mobile build output (OpenOTA_Example, packages/native-android, apps/example) — these are
# regenerated by Gradle/Xcode locally and were never meant to leave the Mac; a single native build
# produces tens of thousands of small intermediate files (dex, desugar graphs, CMake caches) that
# once broke a real deploy (rsync connection reset mid-transfer) before this list existed.
